name: dogfood-postgres-cdc-outbox-app
description: Dogfood app (v1.26-2) — a Postgres 16 logical replication + Debezium-style outbox + Redis Streams consumer pipeline that exercises 4 patterns (outbox write inside a WAL-visible transaction / CDC decoded event with strict LSN ordering / at-least-once delivery to a Redis Streams consumer group / streaming replication with observed replica lag) driven by @kiwa-test/orm in KIWA_MODE=mock and testcontainers Postgres 16 in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip POSTGRES_BOOTSTRAP). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/orm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
